title: Local hosted asset generation.
author: Jolly_Roger-99
selftext: So what local llm are you using to generate assets?

comments.author: 3tt07kjt
comments.body: LLMs only generate text, but there are other types of models I’ve used for generating images. These days, I would mostly use SDXL for images, but it is very unreliable at getting the specific images you want. You can use it for things like character portraits, 2D backgrounds, and title screens as long as you are not picky.

replies.author: Jolly_Roger-99
replies.body:
Ah then i use the wrong Wording - i mean which models are good for generating assets like meshes, riging etc. Or map textures etc

 I have a  strix Halo with 128GB unified memory,  still no useful model to run?

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body: You can try, I just haven’t been impressed with the results.

comments.author: Reign2294
comments.body: Z-image turbo is a good place to start.

replies.author: Jolly_Roger-99
replies.body: Yeah comfy as UI isnplanned, but need some tips for good models

replies.author: Judgegeo
replies.body: Find some examples of what you like on civitai. It will tell you the model as well as other info.
